evidence: e2m 1071 +E EB_Max_Fuel_Threshold 'Fueling threshold above which engine brakes may not be enabled' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (MM3S, 0.0679 mm3 per count; 59 = 4.0 mm3 in the dump): the fuel limit of the engine retarder (exhaust brake). In cm848_updateEngineRetarderEnableState, outside the low speed governor and power take-off states, the enter condition needs final_fueling at or below it and the exit condition fires when adjusted_user_fueling is above it with vehicle_speed at or below engine_retarder_exit_maximum_vehicle_speed_cal; the low speed governor branch also accepts it next to engine_retarder_fuel_demand_threshold_governor_mode_11 + fuel_demand_offset_correction. cm848_updateEngineRetarderActiveState resets engine_retarder_fuel_demand_at_minimum_pass_counter while final_fueling is above it. ROM copy, not EEPROM: no _cal.

e2m 10ED +6 LSG_User_Gain_State '[LSUSGNST] IDENTIFIES THE CURRENT LSG PID GAIN SET' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (0-7; 0 in the dump): the low speed governor's requested PID gain set. cm848_processGovernorLoadCondition sets 1 (governor_active_flag, the speed error is beyond its thresholds; table governor_setpoint_table_cal) or 0; cm848_processGovernorSpeedSetpoint, only while adjusted_user_fueling_state is FUELING_STATE_LOW_SPEED_GOVERNOR, sets 0 / 2 / 3 from the speed error and the drivetrain ratio window (tables governor_setpoint_table_mode2_cal / _mode3_cal) and 0 otherwise. cm848_updateGovernorSetpointParameters copies it into low_speed_governor_final_gain_state (0x40ae7e) when neither override applies (a J1939 TSC1 override or governor_j1939_mode_override take priority there) and loads the four words of the selected table (governor_setpoint_table_a for 0) through governor_setpoint_table_ptr into the gain words at e2m 10ED +0 / +2 / +4 / +14 (0x40ae76 / 78 / 7a / 8a, the LSG P / I / D / jerk gains; 164 / 164 / 77 in the dump, the same as the FSS copies at +C / +E / +10). Word, written by sth.

e2m 10ED +8 LSG_Final_Gain_State '[LSFNGNST] Indicator of the lsg gain set currently being used' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (0-9; 0 in the dump): the low speed governor gain set in use. cm848_updateGovernorSetpointParameters decides it in this priority order: (1) cm848_getGovernorOverrideSource sets 4 (table at j1939_low_speed_governor_proportional_gain) when the J1939 TSC1 governor mode (j1939_tsc1_override_state.governor_mode) is nonzero and bit 0x8000 of governor_feature_flags is set; (2) otherwise cm848_selectGovernorSetpointSource uses governor_j1939_mode_override (0x40ae80, e2m +A FSS_LSG_Override_Gain_State, table at governor_j1939_speed_target) when that word is nonzero (0 in the dump; the application never writes it directly); (3) otherwise it copies low_speed_governor_user_gain_state (0x40ae7c). cm848_calculateGovernorCompensation adds the friction and fuel demand feed forward terms only when it is neither 0 nor 1. Word, written by sth.

e2m 11BF +0 Industrial_Idle_Switch_Save_State '[CTIVSWSS] IVS switch status when Throttle_Validation_Process_Error became active' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (EEPROM 0x92a; 0 in the dump): the idle validation switch (IVS) state saved when the throttle validation process error is set (e2m ADTHPDER 'Error set when throttle pot does not agree with throttle switches'). In cm848_fuelDemandSmoothingController, when fuel_demand_control_t.idle_validation_state stays 2 or 3 (a switch contradicts the pedal band) past its debounce, it sets fault 63 (P2121, bit 0x8000 of fault_detected_bits_48_to_63) and stores switch 7 (accelerator at idle, switch_input_state_bits[0] & 0x80) here as 0 / 1. xref_addr.py finds this one store and no read; EEPROM mirror, so _cal.

e2m 125E +0 Torque_Derate_Override '[FSTQDQUO] Engineering torque derate fueling override' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table: EEPROM 0x380) (MM3S, 0.0679 mm3 per count; 5888 = 400 mm3, the maximum, in the dump): while bit 0x10 of governor_feature_flags is set (the dump has 0x1020, so it is off) cm848_arbitrateRequestedFueling replaces the whole derate chain with it: torque_derate_fuel_quantity = this word and torque_derate_fuel_source_code = FUELING_STATE_TORQUE_DERATE_OVERRIDE (e2m label TRQDROVR). EEPROM mirror, so _cal.

e2m 125E +2 User_Override_Fueling '[FSUOFL] Engineering fueling override' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table: EEPROM 0x382) (MM3S, 0.0679 mm3 per count; 0 in the dump): the engineering fuel override. While bit 0x2 (mask 2) of governor_feature_flags is set (off in the dump) and the engine is running (not stopped, shut down or overspeeding, no immobilizer fuel disable) cm848_selectFinalFueling takes it as the fueling request total_fueling_selected, with final_fueling_state = FUELING_STATE_FUEL_OVERRIDE (e2m label OVERRIDE), and clamps it between fuel_demand_minimum and fuel_demand_maximum. EEPROM mirror, so _cal.

e2m 1735 +0 C_CBP_Residual_Mass_Max 'Max limit on residual mass estimation' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (MM3S, 0.1359 mm3 per count; 1104 = 150 mm3 in the dump): the ceiling of the in-cylinder residual gas mass. cm848_calculateResidualGasMass divides cylinder_residual_gas_mass_density_constant x exhaust_pressure by the exhaust temperature term into cylinder_residual_gas_mass_unclamped and clamps it between cylinder_residual_gas_mass_lower_limit (e2m +2) and this word into cylinder_residual_gas_mass; cm848_calculateCylinderOxygenMasses multiplies that by the residual oxygen fraction. ROM copy (RAM 0x4062d2), not EEPROM: no _cal.

e2m 175F +0 TPE_Corrected_Air_Flow 'Air flow input to compressor map in corporate units' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (KG*SQR(K)/S/MPa, 0.03125 per count; 0 in the dump, engine off): the corrected fresh air mass flow, the flow axis of the compressor map. cm848_estimateCompressorOutletTemperature stores charge_flow_estimate_terms.fresh_air_mass_flow_filtered x compressor_inlet_temperature_square_root / 40000 x 0x2ad5 / compressor_inlet_pressure here (capped at 0xffff) and passes it with compressor_map_corrected_turbocharger_speed (e2m +2) to the dual axis lookup whose output is compressor_outlet_temperature_to_inlet_temperature_ratio (e2m +4). Working RAM, never _cal.

e2m 175F +4 TPE_COT_To_Inlet_Tmptr_Ratio 'Compressor map output in corporate units' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (UNITLESS, 1/2048 per count; 2117 = 1.034 in the dump): the ratio of the compressor outlet temperature to the inlet temperature, read from the compressor map. cm848_estimateCompressorOutletTemperature looks it up with cm848_dualAxisTableInterpolation on compressor_map_corrected_air_flow (e2m +0) and compressor_map_corrected_turbocharger_speed (e2m +2) (tables fuel_timing_boost_scale_axis1_cal / _ystart_cal / _yend_cal), multiplies it by the compressor inlet temperature in Rankine (ambient_air_temperature_selected + 0x7300), converts the product back to degrees F (floored at 0) and filters it into compressor_outlet_temperature. Working RAM, never _cal.

e2m 191B +C Compressor_Outlet_Temperature 'Compressor_Outlet_Temperature virtual sensor value' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (DEG_F, 0.03125 per count; 1662 = 51.9 F in the dump): the virtual sensor copy of compressor_outlet_temperature (e2m 175F +8), the compressor outlet temperature estimate or its calibrated default. cm848_selectCompressorOutletTemperature stores it at the end of every pass; xref_addr.py finds this one store and no read (it sits in the e2m 191B virtual sensor block with exhaust_temperature_virtual_sensor_copy and egr_valve_position_virtual_sensor_copy). e2m 1966 +7C Booster_Cap_1_Volt_Sensor 'Booster_Cap_1_Voltage linearized and filtered value' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (VOLT, 0.000976525 V per count; 640 = 0.625 V in the dump): the filtered value of sensor channel 54, the voltage of the injector driver's first booster capacitor. The channel's tables are injector_group_a_supply_voltage_linearization_axis / _values and its low fault bit 329 (0x149) gives P2146 (fuel injector group A supply voltage), so this is the same signal; cm848_protection_timer_init compares the QADC results of slots 54 and 55 with fuel_system_hardware_shutdown_error_threshold (e2m 8041 +2A, the booster capacitor voltage level). Written through the value output pointer of sensorChannelTypeB_configInit / _update by cm848_initProtectionParameter1 / cm848_processProtectionParameter1 (no direct displacement access). Working RAM, never _cal.

e2m 1B2C +8 Fuel_Pressure_Keyon_Rat_Run_Time 'Maximum amount of time allowed between keyon and engine start' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (CNTS; 20 in the dump): the number of key-on passes the rail pressure sensor key-on check (P0191, fault 414) must have counted with the engine stopped. hpcr_checkRailPressureSensorBeforeStart counts passes in ENGINE_STATE_STOPPED in cam_sync_validation_crank_tick_count (0x3fd1de); once the engine has left STOPPED a count below this aborts the check (fuel_pressure_sensor_pre_start_check_abort_code 5, the e2m's 'keyon too long') and the pass / fail verdict is only taken with the count at or above it. The code compares count < this word, so it acts as a minimum although the e2m text says maximum. Not a cam sync. ROM copy, not EEPROM: no _cal.

e2m 1B2C +C Fuel_Pressure_Rationality_Start_Delay 'Delay after keyon before reading Chry_Dat42 from cluster' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (CNTS; 30 in the dump): the start delay of the rail pressure sensor key-on check (P0191, fault 414). While the check is armed (fuel_pressure_sensor_pre_start_check_state 1) hpcr_checkRailPressureSensorBeforeStart counts cam_sync_validation_dwell_counter (0x3fd1dc) up each pass until it exceeds this word; only then does it read the cluster's engine off time (pci_receive_message_14_engine_off_time) and start sampling the sensor volts, and the verdict also needs the counter past it. Not a cam sync. ROM copy, not EEPROM: no _cal.

e2m 801A +E HPCR_Lowidle_Window 'RPM window for monitoring defect during low idle' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (RPM, 0.125 rpm per count; 0 in the dump): the half width of the speed window of the low idle check in cm848_diagnoseFuelPressureGovernor. Flag 0x40 of fuel_pressure_diagnostic_flags (fuel_pressure_governor_demand above fuel_pressure_governor_demand_limit_at_governed_speed, e2m +C) needs average_engine_speed strictly between governor_output_t.idle_reference_speed (the low speed governor's idle reference speed) minus and plus this word, vehicle_speed_sensor_ok_flag = 1 with vehicle_speed_copy = 0, the coolant above fuel_pressure_governor_demand_check_minimum_coolant_temperature (e2m +10) and final_fueling_state = FUELING_STATE_LOW_SPEED_GOVERNOR. With 0 in the dump the window is empty, so that flag can never set in this calibration. Not a governor integrator hysteresis. ROM copy, not EEPROM: no _cal.

e2m 8A0F +0 Cruise_N_V_Ratio_Int 'Engine Speed/Vehicle Speed ratio integrator for cruise control' (address from the ECU's parameter ID table) (signed, 0.125 per count, -100..100; 0 in the dump): the running sum of the change of the engine speed to vehicle speed (N/V) ratio. governor_cruise_speedError_integrate adds (cruise_rpm_ratio_ema_prev - cruise_rpm_ratio_ema) while the ratio is moving (change at or above cruise_ratio_steady_threshold) and zeroes it once the ratio has been steady for cruise_steady_debounce_count passes; governor_fuel_mode_initialization zeroes it too. governor_cruise_deniedStatus_update denies cruise with code 11 (CLU, the clutch entry of the DRB cutout / denied status order RD / DIS / MUX / VSS / BKER / OFF / BK / CAN / RS / RPM / NV / CLU / PN) when its magnitude reaches cruise_speed_error_integral_limit (e2m 8A0E +A Cruise_N_V_Ratio_Int_Tolerance 'Level at which N_V Ratio integrator will cause a kick out'), only for manual transmissions (transmission_type_cal below 1): a clutch slip detector, not a speed error. Working RAM, never _cal; retyped word -> i16 2026-11-20 (e2m signed, every load lha).
